story.title: 'Ramayana: Part 1': Namit Malhotra gets emotional at Mumbai screening
story.summary: Namit Malhotra became emotional while expressing gratitude at the Mumbai screening of 'Ramayana: Part 1'. He described the film as his heartbeat and highlighted its significance for the team. Malhotra acknowledged the hard work and passion that went into creating the film. Audience reactions after the screening were positive, particularly regarding the visual elements and performances.
